Lumen Home Goods Frequently Asked Questions

Shipping: We ship to the United States and Canada. Standard shipping takes 5 to 7 business days and costs $6.99, or is free on orders over $75. Express shipping takes 2 to 3 business days and costs $14.99. Orders placed before 2 PM EST ship the same day.

Returns and Exchanges: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, as long as the item is unused and in its original packaging. Custom or made-to-order furniture is final sale and cannot be returned. To start a return, email returns@lumenhomegoods.com with your order number.

Warranty: All furniture comes with a 2-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. This warranty does not cover normal wear and tear, water damage, or damage from improper assembly.

Business Hours: Our customer support team is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM EST. We are closed on major US holidays. Live chat on our website is available during these same hours.

Assembly: Most furniture items require assembly. Assembly instructions and hardware are included in the box. Video assembly guides are available on our YouTube channel for our top 20 best-selling items.

Price Match: We offer price matching within 14 days of purchase if you find the identical item in stock at a lower price from a major competitor. Contact support with a link to the competitor's listing.
